source.title: Statement in the Assembly Bomb Case

passages.excerpt_preview: hagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt stated that they threw bombs in the Central Legislative Assembly on 8 April 1929 in protest against repressive bills and to make the deaf hear.
The statement presents the action as propaganda by deed and connects revolution to an end of exploitation, while accepting responsibility for the act.
They said the bombs were not intended to kill and had been thrown in empty spaces after care to avoid casualties.
